vintage: GUS population 2026-06-30; population 2025-12-31 for change since 2015, density, births, deaths and migration; demographic rates and life expectancy 2025; university students 2025-12-31; territorial division 2026-01-01; PKW: presidential election runoffs of 2015-05-24 and 2020-07-12; presidential election 2025 (rounds of 18 May and 2025-06-01); Sejm 2023 (2023-10-15)

lenses.name: Density
lenses.description: Residents per km² (GUS, 2026-06-30; area on 2026-01-01). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Median age
lenses.description: Median age of residents, worked out from the GUS five-year age groups of 2026-06-30 by linear interpolation inside the group that holds the middle resident. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Change 2015-2025
lenses.description: Population on 2025-12-31 ÷ population on 2015-12-31 - 1 (GUS). Each year is on its own borders, so gminas whose borders changed (Opole and four neighbours in 2017; Kamienica, Szczawa, Supraśl and Grabówka in 2025) show no change. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Gminas whose borders changed since 2015 (Opole and its neighbours, Kamienica, Supraśl) show no change.

lenses.name: Net migration
lenses.description: People who moved in minus people who moved out, within Poland and from abroad, per 1,000 residents (GUS, 2025). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Aged 65+
lenses.description: Residents aged 65 or more ÷ all residents (GUS, 2026-06-30). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Births
lenses.description: Live births per 1,000 residents (GUS, 2025). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Ukrainians (PESEL UKR)
lenses.description: Ukrainian citizens with a PESEL UKR number (temporary protection) registered in the powiat, per 1,000 residents. The register shows where the number was issued, not where the person lives now. Published per powiat: every gmina shows its powiat's value. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Per powiat. Counts where the PESEL UKR number was issued, not where people live now.

lenses.name: PIT revenue per person
lenses.description: The gmina's share of personal income tax planned for 2026 ÷ residents (Ministry of Finance, GUS population of 2025-12-31). It follows residents' taxable incomes. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Follows the taxable income of residents.

lenses.name: Average wage
lenses.description: Average gross monthly wage, by employer seat (GUS wage distribution, 2026-05). Published per powiat: every gmina shows its powiat's value. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Unemployment
lenses.description: Registered unemployment rate, end of 2026-10 (GUS). Published per powiat: every gmina shows its powiat's value. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: University students
lenses.description: Students of the universities in the gmina, per 1,000 residents (GUS, 2025-12-31). A student on two programmes counts twice. Gminas without a university are blank. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Only gminas with a university have a value.

lenses.name: Doctors
lenses.description: Doctors counted at their main place of work, per 10,000 residents (GUS, 2024). City powiats with big hospitals rank high, the rural powiats around them low. Published per powiat: every gmina shows its powiat's value. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Per powiat. Counted at the hospital or clinic, so city powiats rank high.

lenses.name: Life expectancy, women
lenses.description: Life expectancy at birth of women (GUS, 2025). Published per voivodeship: every gmina shows its voivodeship's value. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Life expectancy, men
lenses.description: Life expectancy at birth of men (GUS, 2025). Published per voivodeship: every gmina shows its voivodeship's value. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Roman Catholic
lenses.description: Residents who declared the Roman Catholic Church, as a share of all residents (NSP 2021 census). About a fifth of residents (21% in Poland) did not answer the voluntary question. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: The census question was voluntary: about a fifth of residents did not answer.

lenses.name: No religion
lenses.description: Residents who declared no religion, as a share of all residents (NSP 2021 census). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: The census question was voluntary: about a fifth of residents did not answer.

lenses.name: Mass attendance
lenses.description: Dominicantes: the share of Catholics obliged to attend who were at Sunday Mass on the 2024-10 count (ISKK, Annuarium Statisticum Ecclesiae in Polonia). Published per Catholic diocese: every gmina shows the diocese of its seat. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: President 2025
lenses.description: Second round, 2025-06-01: Karol Nawrocki's share of valid votes (PKW). The rest went to Rafał Trzaskowski.
lenses.note: Per gmina, 2025. Colours split at 50%: teal leans to Trzaskowski, amber to Nawrocki.

lenses.name: Turnout 2025
lenses.description: Valid ballot papers ÷ eligible voters, presidential election second round, 2025-06-01 (PKW). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Sejm 2023
lenses.description: The committee with the most valid votes in the gmina, Sejm election of 2023-10-15 (PKW).
lenses.note: Shows only the committee with the most votes.

lenses.name: PM2.5
lenses.description: Annual mean of PM2.5 in 2025 at the nearest GIOŚ measuring station within 25 km of the gmina's centre. Gminas with no station that close are blank. A station measures its street or district, not the whole gmina. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: The nearest station within 25 km. Blank: no station that close.

lenses.name: 2024 flood
lenses.description: Gminas named in the state of natural disaster declared for the 2024-09 flood (Dz.U. 2024 poz. 1365 and amendments).
lenses.note: A declaration is a legal act that unlocks aid, not a measure of damage.

lenses.name: Higher education
lenses.description: Residents aged 13 or more with a higher-education diploma (NSP 2021 census, 2021-03-31). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: New dwellings
lenses.description: Dwellings completed per 1,000 residents (GUS). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Tourist nights
lenses.description: Nights spent in tourist accommodation with 10 or more beds per resident (GUS). Published per powiat: every gmina shows its powiat's value. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Tourist nights in selected cities
lenses.description: Nights spent in tourist accommodation with 10 or more beds per resident in published cities (GUS). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Median dwelling price
lenses.description: Median transaction price per square metre of dwellings sold (GUS). Published per powiat: every gmina shows its powiat's value. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Average dwelling price
lenses.description: Average transaction price per square metre of dwellings sold (GUS). Published per powiat: every gmina shows its powiat's value. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Maths exam result
lenses.description: Mean mathematics result in the grade 8 examination (CKE). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Matura pass rate
lenses.description: Share of candidates who passed the matura examination (CKE). Published per powiat: every gmina shows its powiat's value. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Own income
lenses.description: Local government's own income per resident (Ministry of Finance). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Investment spending
lenses.description: Local government's investment spending per resident (Ministry of Finance). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Local government debt
lenses.description: Local government debt per resident (Ministry of Finance). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Passenger cars
lenses.description: Registered passenger cars per 1,000 residents (GUS). Published per powiat: every gmina shows its powiat's value. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Average farm area
lenses.description: Average agricultural holding area in the 2020 Agricultural Census (GUS). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Land in farms
lenses.description: Land in agricultural holdings as a share of the gmina's area in the 2020 Agricultural Census (GUS). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Per gmina, 2020. Land is assigned to the holding's seat.

lenses.name: President 2015
lenses.unit: Andrzej Duda share of valid votes
lenses.description: Second round: Andrzej Duda's share of valid votes. The rest went to Bronisław Komorowski (PKW).

lenses.name: President 2020
lenses.unit: Andrzej Duda share of valid votes
lenses.description: Second round: Andrzej Duda's share of valid votes. The rest went to Rafał Trzaskowski (PKW).

lenses.name: Presidential vote shift, 2020-2025
lenses.description: Karol Nawrocki's 2025 second-round share minus Andrzej Duda's 2020 second-round share (PKW).

lenses.name: Silesian identity
lenses.description: Residents who declared a Silesian national or ethnic identity, as the first or the second of two possible answers, as a share of all residents (NSP 2021 census, 2021-03-31). GUS lists an identity in a gmina only when at least 10 people declared it. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Per gmina, NSP 2021 census (2021-03-31, GUS). Blank: fewer than 10 people declared it.

lenses.name: Kashubian identity
lenses.description: Residents who declared a Kashubian national or ethnic identity, as the first or the second of two possible answers, as a share of all residents (NSP 2021 census, 2021-03-31). GUS lists an identity in a gmina only when at least 10 people declared it. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Per gmina, NSP 2021 census (2021-03-31, GUS). Blank: fewer than 10 people declared it.

lenses.name: German identity
lenses.description: Residents who declared a German national or ethnic identity, as the first or the second of two possible answers, as a share of all residents (NSP 2021 census, 2021-03-31). GUS lists an identity in a gmina only when at least 10 people declared it. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Per gmina, NSP 2021 census (2021-03-31, GUS). Blank: fewer than 10 people declared it.

lenses.name: Belarusian identity
lenses.description: Residents who declared a Belarusian national or ethnic identity, as the first or the second of two possible answers, as a share of all residents (NSP 2021 census, 2021-03-31). GUS lists an identity in a gmina only when at least 10 people declared it. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Per gmina, NSP 2021 census (2021-03-31, GUS). Blank: fewer than 10 people declared it.

lenses.name: Largest minority identity
lenses.description: The national or ethnic identity other than Polish that the most residents of the gmina declared (first or second answer), NSP 2021 census, 2021-03-31. Identities are named as in the census list; 'Another identity' covers all others (for example English or American). GUS lists an identity in a gmina only when at least 10 people declared it.
lenses.note: Per gmina, NSP 2021 census (2021-03-31, GUS). Blank: no identity other than Polish reached 10 people. Shows only the largest one, however small.

lenses.name: Commuters in
lenses.description: Wage employees who live in another gmina and work in this one, per 1,000 residents of the gmina (NSP 2021 census, 2021-03-31; residents from the same census). Job centres rank high, dormitory suburbs low. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Per gmina, NSP 2021 census (2021-03-31, GUS). Wage employees only: the self-employed and farmers are not counted.

lenses.name: EU co-financing
lenses.description: EU co-financing of the 2021-2027 European Funds projects carried out in the gmina, per resident (project list of 2026-11-01, Ministry of Funds and Regional Policy; residents on 2026-06-30, GUS). Includes the 16 regional programmes and the national ones (FENG, FEnIKS, FERS, FEPW, FERC, technical assistance), fisheries (FER), the home-affairs funds and the Interreg programmes managed in Poland. A project in several gminas is split equally. Projects placed only in a powiat, a voivodeship or the whole country (33.5% of the money) are left out. The Recovery plan (KPO) is not included. Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Per gmina, signed projects on 2026-11-01. A project counts in the gminas where it is carried out. The Recovery plan (KPO) is not included.

lenses.name: Forest
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land with tree cover (ESA WorldCover 2021). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Farmland
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land in cropland or in meadow and pasture below 900 m (ESA WorldCover 2021). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Built-up
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land that is built up (ESA WorldCover 2021). Colours span the 2nd to 98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
